description: Create two missing CRUD pages for locations and rtt_groups following the existing sectors page pattern, and add their cards to the settings page
steps: Create src/app/settings/locations/page.tsx - CRUD for locations table (id, name). Follow the pattern of src/app/settings/sectors/page.tsx but simplified: only 'name' field. Include list, add (inline form), edit, delete with confirmation. Use 'use client', createClient from @/lib/supabase/client, lucide-react icons (MapPin, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, ArrowLeft). Show count in subtitle. Link back to /settings.

Create src/app/settings/rtt-groups/page.tsx - CRUD for rtt_groups table (id, name). Same pattern as locations but for rtt_groups table. Use Users icon or similar from lucide-react. Same inline form pattern with add/edit/delete.

Update src/app/settings/page.tsx to add two new cards: (1) 'Sites' card linking to /settings/locations with MapPin icon, description 'Gerer les sites / implantations', (2) 'Groupes RTT' card linking to /settings/rtt-groups with Users icon, description 'Gerer les groupes RTT pour les secteurs'. Place them after the Secteurs card.

src/app/settings/rtt-groups/page.tsx exists and implements full CRUD for the rtt_groups table
